newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom to spend 5 bln rgt on MSC infrastructure.
newsitem.headline: Telekom to spend 5 bln rgt on MSC infrastructure.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd will spend about five billion ringgit on developing its telecommunications infrastructure for the country's Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC) project until 2005, the national Bernama news agency reported on Sunday.

The expenditure will go towards building the MSC's basic infrastructure -- a fibre optic-based telecommunications backbone and customer access network, Bernama quoted Telekom mega project division general manager, Mohd Taib Hassan, as saying.

The MSC, conceived by Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, is a proposed 15 kilometre by 40 kilometre corridor stretching south from Kuala Lumpur to a new international airport and new administrative capital called Putrajaya.
Mohd Taib said the first phase of the fibre-based network would be completed by June or July next year in Putrajaya.
He said the MSC telecommunications network would be part of Telekom's corporate information project which has been developed in stages since last year.
